questions.explanation: Amoebiasis is not a sexually transmitted disease; it is caused by a parasite and is typically spread through contaminated food or water. In contrast, AIDS, Gonorrhea, and Syphilis are all sexually transmitted diseases. Therefore, the correct answer is Option B: Amoebiasis.

questions.question_english: Which of the following eras is considered as the age of the dinosaurs?
questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से किस युग को डायनासोरों का युग माना जाता है?
questions.explanation_english: The Mesozoic era is known as the age of dinosaurs because it is the period during which dinosaurs thrived and dominated the Earth. This era lasted from about 252 to 66 million years ago and is divided into three periods: Triassic, Jurassic, and Cretaceous. The other options, such as Cenozoic, are periods that came after the dinosaurs, while Precambrian and Paleozoic are much earlier periods that did not feature dinosaurs as the dominant life forms.
questions.explanation_hindi: मेसोज़ोइक युग को डायनासोरों का युग माना जाता है क्योंकि यह वह समय था जब डायनासोर पृथ्वी पर प्रबल और प्रमुख जीव थे। यह युग लगभग 252 से 66 मिलियन वर्ष पहले तक चला और इसे तीन अवधियों में विभाजित किया गया: ट्राइसिक, जुरासिक, और क्रेटेशियस। अन्य विकल्प, जैसे कि सीनोज़ोइक, वे अवधियाँ हैं जो डायनासोरों के बाद आईं, जबकि प्रीकैम्ब्रियन और पैलियोज़ोइक बहुत पहले की अवधियाँ हैं जिनमें डायनासोर प्रमुख जीवन रूप नहीं थे।
questions.explanation: The Mesozoic era is known as the age of dinosaurs because it is the period during which dinosaurs thrived and dominated the Earth. This era lasted from about 252 to 66 million years ago and is divided into three periods: Triassic, Jurassic, and Cretaceous. The other options, such as Cenozoic, are periods that came after the dinosaurs, while Precambrian and Paleozoic are much earlier periods that did not feature dinosaurs as the dominant life forms.

questions.question_english: The formula for calculating Net National Product (NNP) is ______.
questions.question_hindi: शुद्ध राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद (NNP) की गणना के लिए सूत्र ______ है।
questions.explanation_english: The formula for calculating Net National Product (NNP) is GNP minus depreciation. GNP (Gross National Product) accounts for the total economic output of a country, while depreciation represents the loss of value of capital goods over time. By subtracting depreciation from GNP, we obtain the NNP, which reflects the actual economic productivity. The other options are incorrect as they either add depreciation or use GDP instead of GNP.
questions.explanation_hindi: शुद्ध राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद (NNP) की गणना के लिए सूत्र GNP में से मूल्यह्रास घटाना है। GNP (सकल राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद) एक देश की कुल आर्थिक उत्पादन को दर्शाता है, जबकि मूल्यह्रास समय के साथ पूंजीगत वस्तुओं के मूल्य की हानि को दर्शाता है। GNP में से मूल्यह्रास घटाकर, हमें NNP प्राप्त होता है, जो वास्तविक आर्थिक उत्पादकता को दर्शाता है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे मूल्यह्रास को जोड़ते हैं या GNP के बजाय GDP का उपयोग करते हैं।
questions.explanation: The formula for calculating Net National Product (NNP) is GNP minus depreciation. GNP (Gross National Product) accounts for the total economic output of a country, while depreciation represents the loss of value of capital goods over time. By subtracting depreciation from GNP, we obtain the NNP, which reflects the actual economic productivity. The other options are incorrect as they either add depreciation or use GDP instead of GNP.
